title: The heat-kernel master field on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ at strong coupling
summary: We solve large-$N$ Yang--Mills theory on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, for every $d\geq2$, at strong coupling, for structure group $\mathrm U(N)$ and for the heat-kernel action. More precisely, we prove that normalized Wilson loop expectations have infinite-volume large-$N$ limits, factorize at leading order, and admit an all-order $1/N$-expansion with exponentially local coefficients, whose leading order characterizes the master field. We also prove an area-law upper bound for the heat-kernel master field, with a stronger coefficientwise version. The proof is based on a rooted heat-kernel master loop…
